bathing_coastal_transitional.basis: Irish Bathing Water Quality Regulations 2008, Schedule 4. Excellent and Good use 95th percentile; Sufficient uses 90th percentile. Single samples are shown as interpretive screening context only.

hydrometry.basis: OPW station-specific level, flow, percentile and threshold context where available.
hydrometry.note: There is no universal national water-level threshold. Interpret by station, percentile, trend, local flood context and field conditions.

wfd_chemistry.basis: Waterbody-type-specific WFD standards and EPA classification context.
wfd_chemistry.note: The app does not apply a single national nutrient threshold across all waters.

groundwater.basis: Groundwater chemical-status standards and threshold values require groundwater body, pollutant and assessment context.
groundwater.note: Groundwater values are interpreted as screening/context until the relevant groundwater body and assessment basis are joined.
